_comment: English localization table for error codes. See specs/11_error_code_catalog.md.
error.connection.self_connection: A connection cannot have the same source and target port.
error.connection.missing_source_componen: Source component {source_id} does not exist in the workspace.
error.connection.missing_target_componen: Target component {target_id} does not exist in the workspace.
error.connection.missing_source_port: Source port {port_id} does not exist on component {component_id}.
error.connection.missing_target_port: Target port {port_id} does not exist on component {component_id}.
error.connection.locked_component: Cannot modify a connection attached to locked component {component_id}.
warning.connection.dangling_after_delete: Connection {connection_id} became dangling after component deletion.
warning.connection.routing_invalid: Connection routing waypoints are invalid; falling back to default routing.
error.component.locked_delete: Cannot delete locked component {component_id} without explicit unlock.
warning.component.display_id_collision: Display ID collision detected: {display_id} used by multiple components.
warning.component.unknown_field_preserve: Component {component_id} contains unknown field {field_name}; preserved for forward compatibility.
error.parameter.out_of_range: Parameter {parameter_id} value {value} is outside the allowed range [{min}, {max}].
error.parameter.invalid_enum: Parameter {parameter_id} value {value} is not in the allowed set {allowed_values}.
error.parameter.unit_mismatch: Parameter {parameter_id} unit {unit} is incompatible with expected unit {expected_unit}.
error.parameter.expression_parse_failed: Parameter {parameter_id} expression could not be parsed: {expression}.
warning.parameter.out_of_recommended_ran: Parameter {parameter_id} value {value} is outside the recommended range [{min}, {max}].
warning.parameter.unit_normalized: Parameter {parameter_id} unit was normalized from {original_unit} to {canonical_unit}.
error.port.definition_not_found: Port {port_id} does not exist on component definition {definition_id}.
error.port.kind_unsupported: Port kind {kind} is not supported in current Phase.
error.domain.not_registered: Domain {domain_id} is not registered in DomainRegistry.
error.domain.cross_domain_node: Implicit node contains ports from multiple domains: {domains}.
warning.domain.deferred_domain: Component {component_id} belongs to a deferred domain {domain_id}.
error.library.attribution_missing: Third-party SVG {svg_id} has no attribution metadata.
error.library.drag_payload_invalid: Drag payload from library panel is malformed.
warning.library.optional_component_skipp: Optional component {definition_id} was skipped during library load.
error.validation.missing_ground: Electrical model has no Ground reference.
error.validation.missing_fixed_reference: Mechanical model has no Fixed reference.
warning.validation.unused_port: Required port {port_id} on component {component_id} is unused.
error.validation.simulation_stop_time_le: Simulation stop_time ({stop_time}) must be greater than start_time ({start_time}).
error.validation.simulation_max_step_non: Simulation max_step ({max_step}) must be positive when provided; pass null to disable the cap.
warning.validation.unsupported_controlle: Controller {controller_id} has controller_type {controller_type}, which is outside the Phase-1 set (P, PI, PD, PID).
warning.validation.unsupported_solver: Solver {solver} is outside the Phase-1 supported set (auto, fixed_step, variable_step).
warning.validation.stale_controller_inpu: Enabled controller {controller_id} references input {input_ref}, which is not present in io_selection.inputs.
warning.validation.stale_controller_outp: Enabled controller {controller_id} references output {output_ref}, which is not present in io_selection.outputs.
warning.validation.stale_io_component_re: I/O entry {io_entry_id} references component {component_id}, which is not present in the workspace.
warning.validation.stale_io_port_ref: I/O entry {io_entry_id} references port {port_id}, which is not declared on the target component's definition.
error.persistence.external_modification_: Project package was modified externally during the session.
error.persistence.save_blocked_by_unreso: Save was blocked due to unresolved port references.
warning.persistence.unknown_field_preser: Project file contains unknown field {field_name}; preserved for forward compatibility.
warning.persistence.legacy_format_migrat: Legacy single-file project was migrated to package format.
fatal.persistence.save_corrupted_recover: Save failed mid-write; recovery file may be corrupt.
error.migration.no_path: No migration path from version {from_version} to {to_version}.
error.migration.target_version_unknown: Project file uses schema version {schema_version}, newer than application supports.
warning.migration.field_dropped: Field {field_name} was dropped during migration from {from_version}.
warning.migration.field_renamed: Field {old_name} was renamed to {new_name} during migration.
info.recovery.available: A recovery file is available for project {project_name}.
warning.recovery.outdated: Recovery file is older than the last saved state.
error.recovery.load_failed: Recovery file could not be loaded: {reason}.
error.id.ulid_generation_failed: ULID generation produced an invalid result.
warning.id.display_counter_reconstructed: Display ID counters were rebuilt from existing project data.
warning.id.display_counter_collision: Display ID collision detected during counter reconstruction.
warning.command.merge_conflict: Two undoable commands could not be merged due to conflicting state.
error.command.invalid_state: Command attempted to apply to a model in an unexpected state.
fatal.system.unhandled_exception: An unhandled exception escaped the main event loop.
error.equation.dae_index_too_high: DAE index {index} exceeds supported reduction depth {max_index}.
warning.equation.linearity_unknown: Could not determine linearity hint for ODE artifact.
error.solver.non_finite_result: Solver produced non-finite values at t={time}.
error.solver.timeout: Solver exceeded configured timeout of {timeout_seconds} seconds.
warning.simulation.fallback_to_scipy: CasADi backend unavailable; falling back to SciPy.
error.analysis.operating_point_invalid: Operating point is invalid for analysis: {reason}.
warning.analysis.nonlinear_warning: Linearization performed on a nonlinear system; results are approximate.
error.controller.runtime_step_failed: Controller runtime step computation failed at t={time}: {reason}.
warning.controller.output_at_limit: Controller output is near the limit {limit} (current: {value}).
error.plot.artifact_missing: Required artifact for plot type {plot_type} is missing.
error.plot.channel_not_found: Selected channel {channel} does not exist in the artifact.
error.plot.io_pair_invalid: Selected I/O pair (input={input}, output={output}) is not valid for the artifact.
warning.plot.unknown_plot_type: Plot type {plot_type} is not recognized; placed in Unknown group.
warning.io.hdf5_file_missing: Result reference points to missing HDF5 file: {path}.
warning.parameter.out_of_range: Parameter {parameter_id} value {value} is out of range [{min}, {max}].
